description: The mobile app backend (P1) processes the location data received from the parent. This processing may reveal the child's precise location or history, which could be used to identify the individual.

This constitutes unnecessary data disclosure, as the backend only needs to serve a general map/history view, not the granular location history itself.

This is a genuine threat because the user is not aware that their location history is being processed and stored by the backend, which violates the principle of transparency and user awareness.
